title: Skill-Based Overseer Routing: Directing Each Task to the Overseer With the Relevant Skill Set

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: routing tasks to the best-matched overseer could improve quality. But this is an optimization of existing oversight rather than identifying fundamental safety properties or failure modes.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires profiling multiple overseers on different task types, implementing a routing system, and comparing against a generalist baseline. The profiling step is straightforward but the routing logic needs design. Doable with mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple overseers to profile, routing logic to implement, comparison against baseline. If limited to 3 overseers and 3 task types, this is manageable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
